fields.is_bit_parent: true on an address-level row whose bits are described in one table in the manual; its description covers all bits
fields.detail_in_parent: true on a per-bit row whose detailed text lives on the parent row (same address, bit null)
fields.shared_row_with: Other addresses the manual documents in the same row (e.g. the same setting for barriers 1-4)

Setting a value outside 0 to 32767 assumes S13 = 200.

parameters.name: G01 in-position width
parameters.meaning: G01 in-position width
parameters.description: Set the inposition width for G01. The in-position check for G01 is effective when one of G09 (exact stop check), G61 (exact stop check mode) and the error detection is selected with the parameter K95 bit 7 set to 1. For utilizing the in-position width for G01, set the in-position width of the servo parameter to 0 to avoid trouble. Note : 1. This parameter is valid only when bit 3 of M19 is 0. 2. Setting a value outside 0 to 32767 assumes S14 = 50.

parameters.name: Time-out period for releasing the emergency stop status during powering on
parameters.meaning: Time-out period for releasing the emergency stop status during powering on
parameters.description: This parameter allows you to make the preset time for canceling the emergency stop status at powering on (hotline disconnection time) variable. 0: 1000 ms 1 to 7: 8 ms 8 to 3000: The time-out period is set according to the setting. Beyond 3000: 3000 ms Note : 1. Set the value for the first axis (X-axis). 2. Setting a negative value invalidates this parameter and the hotline is disconnected for 7.1 ms. 3. When this parameter is valid, the time taken to cancel the emergency stop status is output to register R71. When the ready lamp turning on process has failed due to a communication error, “0” is output to the register R71.

parameters.description: Set the G0 in-position width to be used when the rapid feed overlapping function is valid. If a value outside the setting range is set, operation is carried out with the upper limit value (10000000) or lower limit value (0).

parameters.description: Sets the in-position width for rapid feed overlapping at joints between consecutively specified G00 in the tool tip point control or cutting point command mode. If a value outside the setting range is set, operation is carried out with the upper limit value (10000000) or lower limit value (0). When 0 is set, the value set for S49 (Rapid feed overlapping function: G0 in-position width) is used. [Related parameters] S49

If a value outside the setting range is set, operation is carried out with the upper limit value (10000000) or lower limit value (0). parameters.name: Amount of offset for height axis rotational center offset (K124, K128) of the rotary axis for the tool (tool tip point control)
parameters.meaning: Amount of offset for height axis rotational center offset (K124, K128) of the rotary axis for the tool (tool tip point control)
parameters.description: Amount of offset for height axis rotational center offset (K124, K128) of the rotary axis for the tool <If the first rotary axis rotates for tool control> Set the amount of offset for the distance (K124) from the rotational center of the tool control rotary axis (at the tool side) in the direction of the height axis to the rotational center of the tool control rotary axis (at the opposite side). * Height axis rotational center offset of the rotary axis at the tool side = K124 + J121 <If the second rotary axis rotates for tool control> Set the amount of offset for the distance (K128) from the spindle holder end in the direction of the height axis to the rotational center of the tool control rotary axis (at the tool side). * Height axis rotational center offset of the rotary axis at the tool side = K128 + J121 * This parameter can be altered by using system variable #6022.

parameters.name: M codes for SPRINT control [Option]
parameters.meaning: M codes for SPRINT control [Option]
parameters.description: Set the M codes for SPRINT control. When parameter J124 = 0 M558: Start signal ON M559: Start signal OFF M574: Enable signal ON M575: Enable signal OFF M576: Select signal ON M577: Select signal OFF When parameter J124 ≠ 0 M [parameter J124 setting value]: Start signal ON M [parameter J124 setting value + 1]: Start signal OFF M [parameter J124 setting value + 2]: Enable signal ON M [parameter J124 setting value + 3]: Enable signal OFF M [parameter J124 setting value + 4]: Select signal ON M [parameter J124 setting value + 5]: Select signal OFF Note : Set the first M code number from which six consecutive unused M codes are available.

parameters.name: Software limit relative position check – Limit distance in the separating direction (1st set of axes)
parameters.meaning: Software limit relative position check – Limit distance in the separating direction J251: 1st set of axes J252: 2nd set of axes J253: 3rd set of axes J254: 4th set of axes
parameters.description: For any two axes that run on the same slideway, the maximum distance that those axes can be separated from each other is set to prevent damage to the way covers. If the two axes are going to be separated beyond the value set for this parameter, a software limit alarm is output to stop the axis movement. Using parameters J251 to J254, the maximum separating distances can be set for up to four axes. Set the machine coordinate of the check target axis, set at parameters L117 to L120, existing at the permissible most separated position from the check reference axis, set at parameters L113 to L116, which is located at the home position. Example : In the example shown below, if the W-axis and the Z2-axis are defined as the check reference axis and the check target axis, respectively, set the machine coordinate of the Z2-axis existing at the permissible most separated position from the W-axis, which is located at the home position. If zero is entered, the checking function in the separating direction will be invalid. Note that the check is possible only for the combination of NC axes. machine zero point machine zero point

parameters.meaning: Horizontal axis rotational center offset of the first rotary axis
parameters.description: <If the first rotary axis rotates for tool control> Set the distance from the rotational center of the tool control rotary axis (at the tool side) in the direction of the horizontal axis to the rotational center of the tool control rotary axis (at the opposite side). <If the first rotary axis rotates for table control> Set the distance from the spindle tip point in the direction of the horizontal axis to the rotational center of the table control rotary axis (at the opposite side) when all axes are in the machine home position.

parameters.name: Vertical axis rotational center offset of the first rotary axis

parameters.name: Height axis rotational center offset of the first rotary axis
parameters.meaning: Height axis rotational center offset of the first rotary axis
parameters.description: <If the first rotary axis rotates for tool control> Set the distance from the rotational center of the tool control rotary axis (at the tool side) in the direction of the height axis to the rotational center of the tool control rotary axis (at the opposite side). Note : In the case of machines with the capability of Maza-Check, the height axis rotational center offset is equal to K124 + J121 (amount of height axis rotational center offset of the rotary axis on the tool side). <If the first rotary axis rotates for table control> Set the distance from the spindle tip point in the direction of the height axis to the rotational center of the table control rotary axis (at the opposite side) when all axes are in the machine home position. Note : When K113 = 2 (machine type: mix type), K124 has the same meaning as BA62 (amount of offset for the B-axis - spindle). In the case of inch specifications, multiply the BA62 value by 2.54, round off to the nearest whole number, and enter this value to K124.

parameters.name: Coordinate measurement - plane inclination C, Skipping stroke limit
parameters.meaning: Coordinate measurement - plane inclination C, Skipping stroke limit
parameters.description: Sets the limit of travel at a skip feedrate while executing coordinate measurement (plane inclination C measurement). If the touch sensor does not come into contact with the workpiece even after traveling this distance at a skip feedrate, the alarm 990 MACRO MEASUREMENT ALARM 1 occurs.

parameters.name: Coordinate measurement - plane inclination C, Approach feedrate for temporary measurement
parameters.meaning: Coordinate measurement - plane inclination C, Approach feedrate for temporary measurement
parameters.description: Sets the approach feedrate for temporary measurement while executing coordinate measurement (plane inclination C measurement). The approach feedrate for actual measurement while executing coordinate measurement (plane inclination C measurement) follows the setting of parameter K41. Parameter K41: Skip feedrate for G31

parameters.name: Coordinate measurement - plane inclination C, Maximum C-axis angle variation
parameters.meaning: Coordinate measurement - plane inclination C, Maximum C-axis angle variation
parameters.description: Sets the maximum variation of the C-axis inclination angle while executing coordinate measurement (plane inclination C measurement). If the C-axis inclination angle of the measurement plane obtained through measurement is greater than the value set for this parameter, the alarm 996 MACRO MEASUREMENT ALARM 7 occurs.

parameters.name: Coordinate measurement - plane inclination C, Number of re-measurements
parameters.meaning: Coordinate measurement - plane inclination C, Number of re-measurements
parameters.description: Sets the maximum number of re-measurements while executing coordinate measurement (plane inclination C measurement). If the number of re-measurements has exceeded the value set for this parameter, the alarm 997 MACRO MEASUREMENT ALARM 8 occurs.

parameters.name: Coordinate measurement - plane inclination C, Permissible difference for skip coordinates X
parameters.meaning: Coordinate measurement - plane inclination C, Permissible difference for skip coordinates X
parameters.description: Sets the permissible difference between the skip coordinates X at the first and second points while executing coordinate measurement (plane inclination C measurement). If the difference between the skip coordinates X exceeds the value set for this parameter, measurement is performed again. The set value is taken as an absolute value.

parameters.name: Coordinate measurement - plane inclination C, C-axis angle shift during retry operation
parameters.meaning: Coordinate measurement - plane inclination C, C-axis angle shift during retry operation
parameters.description: Sets the C-axis angle shift during retry operation while executing coordinate measurement (plane inclination C measurement). When 0 is set, no retry operation is performed. When other than 0 is set, a maximum of two retry operations are performed.  For the first retry operation, C-axis angle at the start of measurement + K224  For the second retry operation, C-axis angle at the start of measurement – K224 If the sensor comes ON during approach for measurement after the second retry operation, the alarm 991 MACRO MEASUREMENT ALARM 2 occurs.

parameters.name: Permissible error at involute interpolation end point
parameters.meaning: Permissible error at involute interpolation end point
parameters.description: Permissible error at involute interpolation end point Sets the permissible error between the involute curve that passes the start point and that which passes the end point in involute interpolation. L in the figure corresponds to the involute interpolation error at the end point. If the error L becomes larger than the value set for this parameter, the alarm 817 INCORRECT ARC DATA occurs at the start point of the involute interpolation. Note : When 0 is set, the permissible error at the end point becomes 0, meaning that the alarm 817 INCORRECT ARC DATA occurs unless the curve that passes the start point completely coincides with the curve that passes the end point. When a value outside the setting range is set, 0 is assumed.

parameters.name: Involute interpolation permissible acceleration
parameters.meaning: Involute interpolation permissible acceleration
parameters.description: Sets the maximum acceleration permitted in involute interpolation to clamp the acceleration. The feedrate in the tangential direction can be clamped to maintain the acceleration within the value set for this parameter. Note : When this parameter is set to 0 or a value outside the setting range, the involute acceleration/deceleration clamp function is disabled and the feedrate in the tangential direction becomes constant regardless of the curvature radius.

parameters.name: Involute interpolation minimum feedrate
parameters.meaning: Involute interpolation minimum feedrate
parameters.description: Sets the minimum feedrate permitted in involute interpolation to clamp the acceleration. When the lower limit for the clamping feedrate is set for this parameter, the feedrate in the tangential direction is adjusted so that it does not go below the lower limit. Note : 1. When a value outside the setting range is set, 0 is assumed. 2. This parameter is valid when K247 > 0.

parameters.name: Involute interpolation override lower limit
parameters.meaning: Involute interpolation override lower limit
parameters.description: Sets the lower limit for the involute interpolation override. When this parameter is set, the override is adjusted according to the curvature radius so that the feedrate at the cutting position becomes the specified feedrate, with respect to the feedrate at the tool center path. Note : When this parameter is set to 0 or a value outside the setting range, the involute interpolation override function is disabled and the override is always set to 100% during tool radius offset.

parameters.name: Spindle speed supervisory mode 3 for safety supervision
parameters.meaning: Spindle speed supervisory mode 3 for safety supervision
parameters.description: Set the spindle speed to be monitored in safety supervisory mode 3. If the operating speed of the spindle exceeds the set value in safety supervisory mode 3, this will cause a safety supervisory alarm and bring the machine to an emergency stop. Assign a value greater than the speed value to be monitored in mode 2 (i.e., specified in SA114).

parameters.name: Spindle safety clamping mode 2 for safety supervision
parameters.meaning: Spindle safety clamping mode 2 for safety supervision
parameters.description: Set the spindle safety clamping speed to be monitored in safety supervisory mode 2. In safety supervisory mode 2 and while a safety clamping request is in effect, the spindle is decelerated to the set speed. Assign a value smaller than the speed value to be monitored in mode 2 (i.e., specified in SA114).

parameters.name: Spindle safety clamping mode 3 for safety supervision
parameters.meaning: Spindle safety clamping mode 3 for safety supervision
parameters.description: Set the spindle safety clamping speed to be monitored in safety supervisory mode 3. In safety supervisory mode 3 and while a safety clamping request is in effect, the spindle is decelerated to the set speed. Assign a value smaller than the speed value to be monitored in mode 3 (i.e., specified in SA115). Assign a value greater than the speed value to be monitored in mode 2 (i.e., specified in SA116).

parameters.name: Selecting the spindle door of the spindle whose speed is to be monitored
parameters.meaning: Selecting the spindle door of the spindle whose speed is to be monitored
parameters.description: Select the door group to which the spindle belongs in safety supervisory mode. If SP129: SFNC9/bit F is OFF, speed monitoring will not be conducted, irrespective of the setting of this parameter. [Examples of setting] 0000: The spindle does not belong to any door. 0001: The spindle belongs to the door-1 group. 0002: The spindle belongs to the door-2 group. 0003: The spindle belongs to the door-1/2 group.

parameters.name: Deceleration judgment coefficient on safety speed clamping of the spindle to be supervised for safety
parameters.meaning: Deceleration judgment coefficient on safety speed clamping of the spindle to be supervised for safety
parameters.description: For safety speed clamping in safety supervisory mode, when a claming request is input, a clamping signal will be output after the spindle has decelerated to a safety clamping speed. This parameter specifies to what additional percentage of the safety clamping speed the spindle is to be decelerated as the output timing of the speed clamping signal. If 0 is set, the speed clamping signal will be output when the spindle decelerates to a 10% additional speed (i.e., 110% of the safety clamping speed).

parameters.description: Select a roughing priority type for program layout (Rearrangement of milling tool sequence). 0: Rearranging a roughing tool, a normal tool, and a finishing tool, in that order 1: Rearranging a roughing tool, a normal tool, and a finishing tool, in that order Further rearranging each tool with priority given to the same tool (with roughing/finishing tool distinction) 2: Milling to be excluded from tool rearrangement. 3: Rearranging each tool with priority given to the same tool (with roughing/finishing tool distinction) 4: Rearranging a roughing tool, a normal tool, and a finishing tool, in that order Further rearranging normal tools in the order of spot drilling  drilling  end milling  chamfering  boring  reaming  back spot facing  back boring  tapping 5: Rearranging a roughing tool, a normal tool, and a finishing tool, in that order Further rearranging normal tools in the order of spot drilling  drilling  end milling  chamfering  boring  reaming  back spot facing  back boring  tapping In addition, for the manual programming unit, assigning priority numbers, judged from the tools to be used

parameters.description: 0: No compensating movement on an unspecified axis till completion of the specified movement 1: Simultaneous compensating movement on all the axes including un- specified one, on condition that the tool number is not changed * Bit 6 of F34 is valid only when G-code series T (Turning machines) is selected and F161 bit 2 is set to 1.

parameters.meaning: Application of Z-OFFSET and C-OFFSET values for the tape operation mode

parameters.description: Used to select operation when running programs in the hard disk or through Ethernet with the INTELLIGENT SAFETY SHIELD enabled for automatic operation. 0: Continue operation 1: Depend on the setting of bit 3 of parameter F35 [Related parameters] F35 bit 3

parameters.meaning: Operation when “ATC” is not specified in end unit
parameters.description: Set the operation pattern when “ATC” is not set in end unit 0: Same operation as when “1” is set for “ATC” (The tool is returned and the axes move to the returning position.) 1: Same operation as when “0” is set for “ATC” (The tool is not returned.)

With modal G01, all the axes are accelerated/decelerated at the smaller rate between those for the axes set for parameters M3/N2. Note : When F68 bit 0 = 1, the composite acceleration/deceleration speed for G53.1 changes if either of the following conditions is satisfied.  G61.1 command  G61.2 command  G64 command (only for modal G00 while constant G00 inclination control is enabled)

Set the sequence number, block number and number of times of repetition as searched from the beginning part of the main program. 1: The subprogram including the desired restart position can be specified. After setting the work number of the corresponding program, set the sequence number, block number, and number of times of repetition as searched from the beginning part.

parameters.description: The basis rate for the NC to judge whether the tool is to be displayed in reverse display mode on the TOOL DATA display to indicate that the life of that tool is approaching expiry. parameters.name: Spline interpolation fairing block length, 5-axis spline interpolation small block length
parameters.meaning: Spline interpolation fairing block length, 5-axis spline interpolation small block length
parameters.description: If a block whose length is less than the value of F103 is detected during fine spline interpolation, that block will be skipped and integrated (faired) into the preceding and succeeding blocks to create a spline curve. Suppose that the i-th block in the fine spline interpolation mode has a block length of l: If I is greater than F103 × 2 i – 1 I is equal to or less than F103 i I is greater than F103 × 2 i + 1 then the ending point of the “i – 1” th block and the starting point of the “i + 1” th block will be modified to the middle point of the i-th block and this block will be deleted. A spline curve will be created from the sequence of points updated this way. If the length of the starting block or ending block in the fine spline interpolation mode is smaller than the value of F103, processing will slightly differ from that described above. This parameter is effective when bit 1 of F96 is 1. If the distance between blocks is less than the value of F103 in the 5-axis spline interpolation mode, the 5-axis spline interpolation mode will be canceled only between these blocks. When F103 is set to 0, the value of parameter F104 is used.

parameters.name: Fine spline interpolation curve error (block including no inflection point), 5-axis spline interpolation curve error, 5-axis fairing command error

parameters.description: During block checking in the fine spline interpolation mode, if the spline curve of a specific block is judged to include no inflection point and the maximum chord error between the spline curve and the block is larger than the value of F104, the shape of the curve will be modified to reduce the maximum chord error below the value of F104. A B During block checking in the 5-axis spline interpolation mode, if the maximum chord error between the spline curve and the block is larger than the value of F104, the shape of the curve will be modified to reduce the maximum chord error below the value of F104. When F104 is set to 0, if the block is judged to include an inflection point, the spline curve of the block will be modified to be linear, and if it is judged to include no inflection point, it will not be modified (spline interpolation is realized). In 5-axis fairing, if the error between the command point and the point after fairing for the tool tip 3 axes is larger the value of F104, the point after fairing is modified to reduce the error below the value of F104. parameters.name: Automatic operation intelligent safety shield (ISS)/virtual machining interference check selection
parameters.meaning: Automatic operation intelligent safety shield (ISS)/virtual machining interference check selection
parameters.description: When an incremental feed command of 720 (two turns) or greater is specified for a rotary type rotary axis, the feed amount of the rotary axis is rounded to one turn + a fraction (remainder obtained by dividing the specified feed amount by 360). Rounding the feed amount increases the speed of the interference check during automatic operation intelligent safety shield (ISS)/virtual machining. The rounding process can be enabled/disabled as follows. 0: Rounding process for rotary axes disabled 1: Rounding process for rotary axes enabled in interference check during automatic ISS 2: Rounding process for rotary axes enabled in interference check during automatic ISS and in virtual machining Example : Change in machining shape due to rounding process with respect to the ZC plane Before applying the After applying the rounding process rounding process Cutting path in C-axis line machining Note : Applying the rounding process to two or more axes including a rotary axis may change the cutting shape and cause interference. Therefore, restrict the use of this parameter to machining in which no interference will be caused due to influence of the rounding process.

parameters.description: Axis setting for selecting the plane used in circular interpolation, cutter radius compensation, tool nose radius compensation, cylindrical interpolation and polar coordinate interpolation. Base axis Parallel axis 1 Parallel axis 2 I SU1 SU2 SU3 J SU4 SU5 SU6 K SU7 SU8 SU9 Enter the ASCII code for the axis name as a decimal number for the parameters. (Example: 88 for the X-axis) When a plane selection command (G17, G18, G19) is specified, the horizontal and vertical axes are determined according to the axis address specified in the same block as the plane selection command. When there are multiple axis addresses that can be candidates for the horizontal and vertical axes of the plane, the axes are selected in this order of priority: “base axis > parallel axis 1 > parallel axis 2”. If there are no axis addresses that can be candidates for the horizontal and vertical axes specified in the same block as the plane selection command, the base axes are selected. The G17 plane takes I in the above table as the horizontal axis and J as the vertical axis. The G18 plane takes K in the above table as the horizontal axis and I as the vertical axis. The G19 plane takes J in the above table as the horizontal axis and K as the vertical axis.

parameters.name: Z-axial withdrawal after M-code unit execution
parameters.meaning: Z-axial withdrawal after M-code unit execution
parameters.description: Z-axial withdrawal after M-code unit execution when the tool nose is positioned at the edge clearance including the workpiece edge protrusion (See example below.) 0: Invalid 1: Valid Example : The tool will be withdrawn after execution of the M-code unit when the tool nose has been positioned in the area between the front clearance point and the workpiece zero point (the hatched section in the figure) using the manual program unit, or when the program is restarted from the M-code unit with the tool nose positioned in that area. Note : bit 1 is valid only when F161 bit 7 is set to 1.

parameters.name: Selection of compensation cancel when working around the workpiece
parameters.meaning: Selection of compensation cancel when working around the workpiece
parameters.description: Change the timing of cancelling the amount of wear compensation (tool offset number set in TPC or wear compensation in tool data) when working around the workpiece with a turning tool mounted. 0: Cancel compensation when working around the workpiece Clearance area 1: Cancel compensation after working around the workpiece Clearance area

parameters.name: Selection of movement from the clearance area to a clearance point during O.D. turning
parameters.meaning: Selection of movement from the clearance area to a clearance point during O.D. turning
parameters.description: Movement onto a clearance point when the tool tip after O.D. turning is located within the clearance area around the workpiece 0: Do not move 1: Move * Operation with this parameter set to 1 (ON) Clearance area

parameters.name: Selection of movement from the clearance area to a clearance point during face/rear turning
parameters.meaning: Selection of movement from the clearance area to a clearance point during face/rear turning
parameters.description: Movement onto a clearance point when the tool tip after face/rear turning is located within the clearance area around the workpiece 0: Do not move 1: Move To the rear To the front Move onto a Clearance area clearance point

parameters.name: W-axis command enabled/disabled during two-workpiece machining
parameters.meaning: W-axis command enabled/disabled during two-workpiece machining
parameters.description: W-axis command from the lower turret when upper - head 1 and lower -head 2 is set in two-workpiece machining unit 0: Impossible 1: Possible (using address B) * The W-axis command can be issued using G110 (cross command) and address B regardless of parameters except for two-workpiece machining unit.

parameters.name: Selection of the zone where spindle override is fixed to 100% during thread cutting cycle

parameters.name: Approach method for ID cutting

parameters.name: Cut depth per cycle for machining external diameter in bar machining unit
parameters.meaning: Cut depth per cycle for machining external diameter in bar machining unit
parameters.description: Set the depth of cut in the Z-axis direction when machining pattern #2 is selected in the external diameter turning unit.
